[SWS_ComM_00980]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09243
⌈If the parameter ComMPncNmRequest is set to TRUE (see [ECUC_ComM_00886]), if
the "FULL Communication" is requested due to a change in the PNC state machine to
COMM_PNC_REQUESTED (see [SWS_ComM_01068]) API Nm_NetworkRequest() shall
be called, even if the current state is already "Full communication".⌋
Rationale: It is the trigger to enable the NM to transmit the NM message immedi-
ately n-times (n=configurable) to ensure a wake up and a synchronization of the PNC
transceiver.
